justification: Minor: changes git index file modes of the four .githooks files to 100755 and adds a CI check that reads those modes. No production code, no database, no user-facing text.

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The hooks were assumed to run everywhere. git ls-tree origin/main .githooks/ showed all four as 100644, which git skips on Linux/macOS.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No existing script reads git index modes (grep for 100755/chmod in scripts/ and .github/ on 1dc64af6 returned nothing).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any .githooks file has index mode other than 100755.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: After git update-index --chmod=-x .githooks/pre-push the check printed '.githooks/pre-push' and exited 1; restored to +x it printed OK and exited 0.

functions.name: non_executable
functions.output: List of .githooks paths whose mode is not 100755
functions.if_none: Empty output returns []; main() reports UNKNOWN and exits 1 when nothing is tracked

break_it.scenario: A later commit (e.g. from Windows, which ignores modes) resets a hook to 100644.
break_it.what_happens: Hooks silently stop running on Linux/macOS again.
break_it.how: gates step 'Git hooks are executable' fails the PR

break_it.scenario: git ls-files output has a malformed line with no mode field.
break_it.what_happens: Check could crash with IndexError and CI shows an error instead of the bad path.
break_it.how: empty mode field is reported as non-executable
main() prints UNKNOWN and exits 1 when nothing is tracked

post_merge.secrets: None -- no secrets or env vars.
post_merge.manual_verify: On a Linux/macOS clone, git commit runs the pre-commit hook output; CI 'Git hooks are executable' step is green.
